owner_request: Prepare clear visual comparisons, collect owner preferences, and define objective and remaining budget before fitting

objective.rank_semantics: 1 best; ties allowed; 1 through 9; rank gaps have no meaning
objective.cell_loss: Number of admissible alternatives ranked strictly better than the candidate / max(1, admissible alternatives - 1)
objective.table_loss: Unweighted mean of the six cell losses
objective.exclusions: Owner appearance exclusions forbid selection; not reclassified as mechanical failures
objective.matched_advance_control: For selected stroke-context widths, also compare width=1 at those exact advances
objective.incomplete_labels: No selection if any row is unreviewed, any cell has no admissible row, or owner has not approved the objective
objective.identity: May win; ties do not force deformation; an owner-excluded identity blocks a three-arm preference claim pending review

budget.p3_packaging: Read-only saved-file indexing and browser layout; no simulation/raster generation; wall time journaled separately
budget.future_budget_status: Exact selected-program inventory and time feasibility still require owner approval; no reset or increase

future_conservative_inventory.scope: Proposal only, staged development then sealed evaluation; no sealed pixels are accessed by this packet
future_conservative_inventory.estimate_limit: Rough extrapolation from prior completed process averages, not a runtime guarantee; no safety margin included
